numbering: Episodes numbered continuously across seasons (Season 2 episode 1 = episode 26), as on Wikipedia; Season 2 is airing, covered through episode 27.

arcs.name: Under One Roof
arcs.summary: Badminton player Taiki Inomata has a crush on basketball star Chinatsu Kano, who unexpectedly moves into his house.
events: Chinatsu moves in with Taiki's family and they agree to keep it secret.
Taiki vows to reach nationals and Chinatsu gives him a good-luck bracelet.
Inspired by Chinatsu, Taiki beats Kishi in a preliminary match.

arcs.name: Inter-High Qualifiers
arcs.summary: Taiki's circle grows closer as both he and Chinatsu chase the Inter-High.
events: Taiki's childhood friend Hina discovers the secret and hurts her ankle.
Taiki loses his qualifying matches while Chinatsu advances to nationals.

arcs.name: Summer Festival
arcs.summary: Summer break brings close calls at home and a festival that complicates everyone's feelings.
events: Taiki falls ill and Chinatsu nurses him, nearly leading to a kiss.
Chinatsu sets boundaries before summer vacation.
Chinatsu sees Taiki with Hina at the festival and is hurt by his earlier lie.

arcs.name: Nationals and Hina's Confession
arcs.summary: Taiki cheers on his friends at nationals as the love triangle comes into the open.
events: On Chinatsu's birthday a storm strands the two at an inn where they clear up misunderstandings.
Chinatsu's mother returns and Hina tells Chinatsu about her confession.

arcs.name: Yusa Match and Culture Festival
arcs.summary: Taiki faces a strong rival on court while the school festival throws him into the spotlight.
events: Taiki replaces the prince in the class play and a prop accident sparks rumors about him and Hina.

arcs.name: Training Camp and Hina's Answer
arcs.summary: A club training camp forces Taiki to face his feelings for both Chinatsu and Hina.
events: Chinatsu admits to Karen that she is interested in Taiki.
At the campfire Taiki turns down Hina, who runs off in tears.
Taiki commits to pursuing Chinatsu, accepting that his friendship with Hina will change.

arcs.name: Season 2
arcs.summary: Taiki and Chinatsu's relationship moves into a new phase as Season 2 begins.
events: Taiki and Chinatsu's outing is interrupted by Matsuoka and Kido.
Kido mocks Chinatsu for having quit basketball.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga.
